🏢 Lunara Tower — Tarrad Development

Brokers report EOI collection announced on 6 October 2026 for this upcoming apartment development in Majan, Wadi Al Safa 3, Dubailand, Dubai. The exact plot is awaiting confirmation.

• 119 homes reported: 105 one-bedroom apartments and 14 two-bedroom apartments with a study
• One-bedroom layouts reported from 530 sq ft
• Broker-indicated prices: 1BR from AED 850,000; 2BR from AED 1.2 million — not developer-confirmed
• Broker-advertised payment plan: 50% on booking and 50% on handover; signed schedule awaited
• Indicative completion: Q1 2029; contractual handover unconfirmed

An early-access opportunity to watch for clients seeking a small apartment development in Majan.

Broker intelligence — medium confidence. This is a reported EOI update following earlier marketing. The EOI amount, refundability, escrow arrangements and current unit availability have not been verified.
